title: Manang registry entry (registry/plugins/<id>.toml, parsed)
description: What an author types. Everything else (name, version, size, hash, permissions) is read from the release's manifest by the build script, never typed by hand.

id.description: Equals the file name, the manifest's [plugin] name, and is kebab-case.

repo.description: The author's GitHub repository, whose releases hold the .manangplugin assets.

readme.description: File name of the readme inside the archive. Optional: the first README* is used.

yanked.description: Versions to leave out of the index (a takedown). Maintainers add to it; authors do not.

release_asset_pattern.description: Which release asset is the plugin. `*` matches any run of characters. Must end in .manangplugin.
